title: 记录 AI 问询 10b：控制台显示核对过的引用，点开记录并定位到被引章节
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbeF2saT6wUBV4E9uc

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-ruled. Split of placeholder #37144 per ruling 7177410380 (the maintainer, decision card, 2026-11-25T23:18Z: Q1 A · Q2 A · Q3 A).
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (topic child) · reach: users of the in-app assistant (the open edition has no AI button, so nothing draws there) · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：控制台的 AI 回答下方列出引用（记录名 + 摘句）。点一条引用就打开这条记录，滚到被引的那一节并高亮。
- 谁受益：使用应用内 AI 的用户。
- 不做会怎样：引用核对过了也看不到，用户无法从回答跳回原文。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts`: `extractRecordCitations(parts)` lifts the `data-record-citations` part through `RecordCitationsSchema` (10a). A part the parse refuses draws no block (precedent `detectAnswerSource`).
2. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/RecordCitations.tsx` (new), drawn in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` beside `AnswerSourceBlock`. Each chip shows the quote. A click calls `onOpenRecord({ objectName, recordId, anchor })`.
3. The citations drawn are the persisted, already-verified list (ruling Q1). The console never re-verifies on display and adds no verify endpoint.
4. A citation opens its `object`/`id`, the pack's root record, even when the quote came from a related-list cell (ruling Q3).
5. `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and `AiChatPage.tsx` `openRecord` gain an optional `anchor`, written as `?section=ANCHOR`.
6. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/urlParams.ts`: `RECORD_SECTION_PARAM = 'section'`, added to `RESERVED_URL_PARAMS`.
7. `RecordDetailView.tsx` reads `section`:
   - It runs the spec's `headingsOf` on the raw body value and takes the Nth heading element in the field's document face (`MarkdownContent.tsx` / rich text).
   - It scrolls to that heading and marks it, as `comment` does.
   - A `textarea` body, or an anchor that does not resolve, scrolls to the field, with no error.
8. i18n keys in every `ui/packages/i18n` locale.

## Acceptance
- The chip opens `/apps/APP/OBJ/record/ID?section=A`, with the section in view and marked. The same holds for the dock and the `/ai` page.
- A citation whose quote came from a related row opens the root record.
- A stale anchor opens the record top.
- A part that fails the parse draws nothing.
- The recordLink grammar is unchanged: fragments are still refused.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`. `Clause-②: yes` (a new reserved URL parameter).

**Out of scope:** verification (10a); producing the part (cloud 10c); inline citation markers in the answer text.

Governing text: ADR-0160 D9 as amended by #37363; ruling 7177410380.
Blocked-by: #37364
Parent: #36996 (row 10b; replaces placeholder #37144)
Size: M
Dedupe (objectstack, is:issue): `citation in:title` → #37144 only (this placeholder).
